title: The derived open-unit cone is supported and quasi-coherent
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, X=Spec(A) [def-pc-scheme], U⊆X a quasi-compact open, and choose derived categories D(O_X) and D of module sheaves on the over-site over U [def-pc-derived-category]. Let F:D(O_X)→D be exact derived open restriction, R any right adjoint of F with adjunction adj, and E an object with quasi-coherent cohomology. For any distinguished triangle E --adj.unit_E→ R(F(E)) --g→ C --h→ E[1], the cone C has quasi-coherent cohomology and F(C) is a zero object.

source.place: Tag 09IR, lemma-orthogonal-koszul-complex, first paragraph; Tag 08D5, qcqs derived direct image; Cohomology, Tag 08FE

proof.text: Use the canonical standard derived localization on the open subscheme and the derived equivalence induced by Scheme.Modules.overEquiv. Transport Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction across overFunctorEquiv to obtain r ⋙ e.functor ⊣ G, with G the underived open direct image. Exactness of restriction makes G preserve K-injective complexes. The proved library theorem Functor.full_rightDerivedFunctor and its faithful counterpart make the derived G fully faithful. Derive the adjunction using mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction, and cancel the derived over equivalence. Adjunction.rightAdjointUniq identifies the resulting right adjoint with the supplied R, transporting fullness and faithfulness.

Compactness of U supplies CompactSpace U and quasiCompact_of_compactSpace gives QuasiCompact U.ι; the open immersion is quasi-separated. Exact restriction preserves quasi-coherent cohomology by [lem-pc-derived-open-restriction-qcoh-iff] and isQuasicoherent_over. Apply [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-qcoh] to U.ι. The composition isomorphism mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and the right-adjoint uniqueness isomorphism transport this property to R(F(E)).

Specialize [lem-pc-supported-qcoh-triangulated] to support Set.univ: the support condition is vacuous, so schemeDerivedQCohProperty is triangulated. Its invariance under isomorphisms follows degreewise from homologyFunctor.mapIso. ObjectProperty.ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₃ applied to the supplied distinguished triangle and hE together with quasi-coherence of R(F(E)) proves quasi-coherence of C.

Fullness and faithfulness of R make adj.counit.app (F.obj E) invertible. The adjunction identity F.map(adj.unit.app E) ≫ adj.counit.app(F.obj E) = 𝟙 gives invertibility of F.map(adj.unit.app E), by isIso_of_comp_hom_eq_id. Exact restriction F.mapDerivedCategory preserves the distinguished triangle. Triangle.isZero₃_of_isIso₁ makes its third object F(C) zero.

theorem derived_open_unit_cone_properties
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens)
    (hqc : IsCompact (U : Set (Spec (.of A))))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (R : DerivedCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over U)) ⥤
      schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (adj : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ R)
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (hE : schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A)) E)
    (C : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (g : R.obj ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E) ⟶ C)
    (h : C ⟶ E⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hT : Triangle.mk (adj.unit.app E) g h ∈ distTriang _) :
    schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A)) C ∧
      IsZero ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
        (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj C)
